title: paeonia × suffruticosa var. jishanensis
intro: Paeonia × suffruticosa var. jishanensis, commonly known as Jishan peony, is a plant species in the Paeoniaceae family. It is an ornamental plant native to China, valued for its beautiful flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Paeonia × suffruticosa var. jishanensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, fibromyalgia, and anxiety. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which have been shown to modulate the immune response and exhibit analgesic and sedative properties.
